summary: ACM Research filed an 8-K reporting a registered direct offering of 2,884,615 shares of Class A common stock at $52/share to Tekne Capital Management. Expected net proceeds are ~$149.85 million for U.S. and global expansion and general corporate purposes. The company agreed to a 6-month lock-up. This is a routine shelf takedown under an effective S-3, not a special situation. No event constitutes a transformative corporate action or structural change.
